Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/49135

Problem Summary:

In distributed framework, we introduced slot manager to control resource.

### What changed and how does it work?

in scheduler(task executor)

- check the available slot before open scheduler
- count the slot by slot manager

issue_context.title: implement scheduler slot manager
issue_context.body:
In distributed framework, we introduced slot manager to control resource.

slot represents the cpu count as usually. A scheduler(task executor) can be opened only when the slot is enough. Otherwise, it will be blocked.

review_comments: better store task itself, priority itself cannot determine task order. ok to do it later
if it's moved out, we have to free on error
